info.bio:
Chumbawamba es una banda de rock inglesa, originalmente realizaban punk rock y con el paso del tiempo se expandieron haciendo estilos como la música electrónica, la World Music y más tarde el folk. Se formaron oficialmente en el año 1982.
La banda esta influenciada por la política anarquista y por una actitud irreverente. Su mayor éxito a nivel de popularidad y ventas, se dio gracias a la canción Tubthumping (1998) del álbum Tubthumper (1997).

scenes.name: Cruces del punk: de Fugazi al punk-pop
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: A finales de los ochenta el punk es el más vivo de los subgéneros del rock: miles de bandas ensayando en garajes, un lenguaje universal como no se veía desde los sesenta. Nueva York: Adrenalin O.D., el straight-edge de Youth Of Today y Gorilla Biscuits, el crossover punk-metal (Cro-Mags, Prong, Danzig). Washington lanza a Pussy Galore (la irrelevancia hecha relevante), Unrest y Fugazi de Ian MacKaye, que abstrae el hardcore en una forma teatral de compromiso ético y estético (Repeater, Steady Diet Of Nothing, Red Medicine), y Royal Trux (Twin Infinitives, «un Trout Mask Replica para la generación grunge»). El punk-pop de Mr T Experience, Dwarves, Henry Rollins, L7 (pioneras del «foxcore»), Lemonheads, Screeching Weasel, Goo Goo Dolls, Fastbacks, Shonen Knife; el «rogue folk» de los Pogues, Membranes y Chumbawamba.

podcast.title: Major Label Deal (1998)
podcast.body: In 1998, Chumbawamba signed a major label record deal, a move that surprised many observers due to its apparent contradiction with the band's staunch anti-capitalist principles and was met with criticism. "And in 1998, they signed a major label record deal, which seemed weird for such an anti-capitalist band."

podcast.title: Eastern European Tape Smuggling
podcast.body: The band engaged in smuggling their tapes into Poland and other Eastern European countries, where music was heavily censored, highlighting their dedication to spreading their message beyond commercial and official channels. "Meanwhile, they smuggled tapes into Poland and other Eastern European countries where music was heavily censored."

podcast.title: Formation and Political Stance
podcast.body: Chumbawamba was formed in Lancashire, England, in 1982. The band was characterized by a strong anarcho-punk attitude and a deep commitment to various left-leaning causes, including class struggle, Marxism, revolution, animal rights, gay liberation, anti-fascism, and anarchist politics, making them an unusual fit for the standard music industry. "Chumbo Wamba was formed in Lancashire, England in 1982."
